correctness.rationale: PASS: For the categorical graph K2×K3×K4, 24 lexicographically numbered vertices are adjacent iff all three coordinates differ; each degree six, total 72 edges. Admissible face condition is induced max degree <=1 (also exclusion of each centered 3-vertex path). Independent construction enumerated exactly 34,910 faces including empty. Ascending-pivot matching yields 17,415 face pairs and critical count one zero-cell plus 78 dimension-five cells; complete orientation of all face-cover relations topologically sorts every one of the 34,909 nonempty faces. Forman CW gives an integral wedge of 78 S^5. This finite graph is exhausted rather than inferred from samples.
